title: Innovating Green: Competition Meets Regulation
authors: Rui Dai; Rui Duan; Lilian Ng
near_miss_reason: stacked DiD only (cohort-specific firm, region and year FE), mostly PPML, triple interaction with competition (anywpint), time-varying firm controls in every column; shipped data are synthetic samples
eligible_reason: The underlying shock (EPA designation of a county as NAAQS nonattainment) switches on at county-specific years, so a staggered binary design exists. All reported specifications, however, are stacked DiD regressions on stacked_did.dta with cohort-specific FE (gvkeycohortid, regioncohortid, yearcohortid), estimated mostly by ppmlhdfe (Poisson) and in Tables 10-11 by reghdfe; every column includes treat, post, interact plus triple interactions with a product-market competition measure (anywp, anywpint, treatint, postint) and time-varying firm controls (logasset tobin_q lev tangibility rdex capexta ocf lnemployeesthissite). Stacked DiD, Poisson, extra treatment interactions and time-varying controls are each excluded. The README states the shipped *_sample.dta files are synthetic (random subset with some values replaced by random draws) and do not reproduce the published results.
design_notes: Firm-county-year panel of U.S. public firms' plants (D&B) linked to PATSTAT green patents, 1996-2021. Treatment: county becomes nonattainment (greenbook_attainment.dta). Stacked by designation cohort (02 SampleConstruction.do). Table 4 main; Table 5 RDD-matched subsample; Table 6 adds county controls and region-year FE; Table 7 import penetration; Table 8 placebo and reversal (reattainment); Table 9 cross-sectional splits; Tables 10-11 OLS outcomes; Table 12 county-level regressions on green innovation with controls. Figure event study: trt_pre_3..trt_post_4 with controls, PPML, split by competition.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Multiple nonattainment-designation cohorts 1996-2021; not counted from synthetic data.
